summary: This clinical trial tested a study drug called GSBR-1290 compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance, in adults who were overweight or obese and adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. The trial investigated how the body processes the drug and its overall safety in 142 participants. The study has now been completed under the identifier NCT05762471.
